name: pose_catalogue_100_both
description: The 100 catalogue poses of docs/pose_catalogue_100.md, camera only, bare hands, both making the pose in one take (record_poses.py --both); pictures are MyoHand renders (palm view, side view), not photographs. Written by scripts/leap/pose_catalogue_protocol.py.
